purpose: Teach: 整体/愛人/クリエイティブ/ディーゼル/ゴジラ/任天堂/ラウンジ/スプリング

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが整体院でメンテされてるそうよ
lines.en: Sho, your dad's been getting his body worked on at that chiropractic clinic.
lines.style: Warm, almost conversational. Gentle delivery—like she's sharing a small, tender detail she noticed. Calm pace, with a slight lift of affection at his name.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、TVの「愛人」って言葉、意味聞いていい?
lines.en: Mei-nee, um… I heard that word on TV, 'mistress.' Can I ask what it means?
lines.style: Soft, hesitant, genuine curiosity without embarrassment. Small voice—the kind of straightforward question only a child can ask. Slightly uncertain, seeking permission to know.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがクリエイティブなお仕事をされてるのよ
lines.en: Sho, your dad does such creative work, you know.
lines.style: Tender and thoughtful. A small reassurance wrapped in admiration. Soft pacing. The tone of someone gently reframing something bigger into something beautiful.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、ディーゼル機関車の絵本好きだよ
lines.en: Mei-nee, I really like the diesel engine picture books!
lines.style: Bright, enthusiastic, eager to share something he loves with her. Genuine delight in the voice—not performed. Quick, open delivery.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがゴジラのフィギュアを下さるそうよ
lines.en: Sho, your dad's going to give you a Godzilla figure, apparently.
lines.style: Soft, affectionate. A gentle announcement of something good. Slight warmth in the tone—she's happy for him. Measured pace, like she's savoring the moment.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、任天堂のゲーム新作待ってるよ
lines.en: Mei-nee, I'm waiting for the new Nintendo game!
lines.style: Bright and eager, with genuine anticipation. Child-like excitement, naturally expressed. Quick pacing. Open, hopeful tone.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがホテルラウンジに連れて行って下さるそうよ
lines.en: Sho, your dad's taking you to the hotel lounge, I hear.
lines.style: Warm, matter-of-fact kindness. Observant tone—she notices the small gifts he gives. Gentle delivery with a touch of knowing appreciation in her voice.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんとスプリングコートを買いに行ったよ
lines.en: Mei-nee, Dad and I went to buy a spring coat together!
lines.style: Bright and satisfied, the voice of a child who has a memory he's proud of. Natural joy in the delivery. Open, connecting tone—eager to share something good with someone he trusts.
